notes.title: Wanderlust Trading Cards have arrived
notes.content:
Our Wanderlust games are all about travelling. And a fun thing about travelling is collecting SOUVENIRS! And we bring you the closest thing you can have in a video game about globetrotting.  

[h3]Wanderlust trading cards, badges, emojis, and free wallpapers, are now available on Steam![/h3]

These are available to the owners of both Wanderlust titles - Travel Stories as well as the standalone Transsiberian. If you're into collectibles, enjoy new additions to your collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38367964/df5405e383a7f59ab107a17aa2ffe28673e7dd08.jpg[/img]

And if you don't own the game yet, we have 50-60% discounts on the titles in the series. Happy trails!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233420/Wanderlust_Transsiberian/

notes.title: UPDATE #1 is live!
notes.content:
Good news!

Our first patch is already live for Windows, macOS & Linux, and that's in large part thanks to YOU. How come? That's because a big chunk of all the changes was based on your feedback! That's right, you helped us make the game better. Isn't that awesome?

[b]Here's what we changed. [i]BEWARE OF SPOILERS![/i][/b]
[i](We can’t avoid them due to the nature of the game.)[/i]

Are you ready?

Are you sure you want to see them?

Last chance…

[u]Okay, here we go:[/u]
[list]
[*] Improved the conditions to unlock [spoiler]the grandfather's tribe[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed the dialogue line when going to [spoiler]look for Daniel[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Anya's goodbye when she's antagonized toward the player[/spoiler].
[*] Transformation descriptions now appear also when calling the NEW_FORM() function.
[*] Edited the [spoiler]banner hanging[/spoiler] scene.
[*] Edited the [spoiler]unicorn[/spoiler] conversation.
[*] Increased the chance for [spoiler]Bartek to die during the hunt[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed the amount of Rage gained during the conversation with Olga.
[*] Fixed the function to calculate Honor.
[*] Various punctuation fixes.
[*] Edited the conversations about [spoiler]Kornel's former pack[/spoiler].
[*] Removed the unnecessary display of Rage during [spoiler]the visions[/spoiler].
[/list]

Your opinion matters, so make sure to leave your review on Steam. Who knows, maybe one day you'll see a change that you suggested or inspired?

See you next time, wolves!
[i]Piotr from Walkabout Games[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342620/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Heart_of_the_Forest/
